decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at N600-09 (radio and CMMS agree). Likely repair is 13:30, so the stope would sit idle with 239 t at 11.9 g/t. LH-08 comes from the cheap infrastructure heading (0.2 oz/h) and arrives in 0.65 h. It loads about 6.3 h at 25.4 t/h, roughly 160 t, which is about 61 oz. The heading loses about 1.4 oz. Norte trucks are slightly limited (inflow 71 vs 66 t/h), but the stockpile has about 208 t of room, so the extra ore still counts. I left LH-09 alone because its heading is critical path (4 oz/h). I didn't use LH-10 because it is in preventive maintenance until 11:00, and one loader is enough for this stope given the truck limit.

LH-01 and LH-03 are down (radio and CMMS agree). Both are likely repaired around 13:30-13:40. I'm keeping LH-08 at N600-09 (11.9 g/t, 234 t). The infrastructure heading it came from costs only 0.2 oz/h. LH-10 comes out of preventive maintenance at 11:00. It travels 0.62 h to N574-02 (10.5 g/t, 194 t), so it loads from about 11:37 to 17:00 at 25.4 t/h. That is about 137 t, or about 46 oz. The Norte stockpile is 248 of 450 t, so the truck limit of 66 t/h does not block it. I'm not taking loaders from producing stopes. The critical-path loader LH-09 costs 4 oz/h, which is too high. Moving LH-06 would only displace ore it would mine anyway.
